subject: science
concept: Understanding basic chemical bonding: how atoms combine to form molecules and compounds
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Properties of Matter) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student combines physical atom models to build simple molecules (like water)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a chemical formula to its correctly built molecule model
exercise.abstract: Student explains, at a basic level, why atoms combine to form molecules and compounds

misconception_flags: confuses an element (one type of atom) with a compound (multiple different atoms bonded together)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
